description: Sewer Subbasins is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. This data shows the sewerage subbasins in Pierce County Sewer Service area. A sewerage basin represents the existing and planned areas from which wastewater is collected and sent to specific wastewater treatment plants. Sewerage basins are often confused with watersheds or drainage basins. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The table has 17 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
